AgentPresetWrite.title: AgentPresetWrite
AgentPresetWrite.description:
One launch-scoped Agent configuration.

The caller names published capability versions; the service resolves and
freezes their identities when it reserves the native Conversation.

AutomaticNodePlanWrite.title: AutomaticNodePlanWrite
AutomaticNodePlanWrite.description: Editable, pre-runtime configuration for one automatic flow node.

AutomaticRunCopyWrite.title: AutomaticRunCopyWrite
AutomaticRunCopyWrite.description: Name an independent draft copied from one frozen automatic run.

AutomaticRunStartWrite.title: AutomaticRunStartWrite
AutomaticRunStartWrite.description: Optimistic-lock the one-way transition from editable draft to Runtime work.

GateAgentPresetWrite.title: GateAgentPresetWrite
GateAgentPresetWrite.description:
The model-only configuration of an isolated gate Agent.

Gate Agents deliberately do not inherit the primary launch's capabilities
or node context.  They receive only the frozen gate payload in a separate
native Conversation.
